metadata.question: Was there more sea ice visible in Hudson Bay (56.271030, -87.160422) on July 29, 2020 than on July 13, 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing sea ice visibility in Hudson Bay between two specific dates in July 2020. I need to: 1. Use satellite data that can detect sea ice - MODIS or Sentinel-1 SAR would be good options 2. Create a geometry around Hudson Bay using the provided coordinates 3. Get imagery for both dates (July 13 and July 29, 2020) 4. Detect sea ice presence and quantify it 5. Compare the amounts For sea ice detection, I'll use MODIS data which has good daily coverage and can detect ice. I'll use the MODIS Terra Surface Reflectance product and look at bands that can help distinguish ice from water. Strategy: - Use MODIS Terra (MOD09GA) for daily surface reflectance - Create a simple ice detection using NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) or brightness thresholds - Count ice pixels for each date - Compare the counts I need to handle: - Checking if images exist for both dates - Counting valid pixels after processing - Validating the results ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const hudsonBayPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-87.160422, 56.271030]); const hudsonBayRegion = hudsonBayPoint.buffer(100000); // 100km buffer around point const date1 = '2020-07-13'; const date2 = '2020-07-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra for daily coverage function getMODISCollection(date) { return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD09GA') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(hudsonBayRegion); } const col1 = getMODISCollection(date1); const col2 = getMODISCollection(date2); // Check if collections have data const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${date1} Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`${date2} Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Simple ice detection using NDSI and brightness function detectIce(img) { // Calculate NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) const ndsi = img.normalizedDifference(['sur_refl_b04', 'sur_refl_b06']); // Use band 1 (red) for brightness threshold const brightness = img.select('sur_refl_b01'); // Simple ice detection: high NDSI and high brightness const iceMask = ndsi.gt(0.4).and(brightness.gt(1000)); return img.addBands(iceMask.rename('ice_mask')); } const img1 = detectIce(col1.first()); const img2 = detectIce(col2.first()); // 4. Count ice pixels const count1 = img1.select('ice_mask').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: hudsonBayRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ice_mask').getInfo(); const count2 = img2.select('ice_mask').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: hudsonBayRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ice_mask').getInfo(); console.log(`${date1} Ice Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`${date2} Ice Pixels: ${count2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === null || count2 === null || isNaN(count1) || isNaN(count2) || count1 < 0 || count2 < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (count1 === 0 && count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (count2 > count1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
